purpose: Trace the Level 01 row-10 upper-platform interaction record through selector 0x87, the generic spawn allocator, and actor initialization.
result: The row-10 source word 0x52E8 dispatches selector 0x87 to 0x001B74D6. The handler calls the generic spawn path, which initializes runtime actor Type 0x01 from template 0x001B7A30 at (4240,384) with animation 0x00122D92. The interaction cell is cleared and scene state remains 0x01; this is an actor-spawn record, not a scene-transition record.
limitations: The run replays from power-on but controls the row pointer, interaction byte, camera fields, and player coordinates at harness frame 1245.
It therefore proves exact-record dispatch and actor semantics, not natural traversal activation of the row-10 record.
next: Trace the natural lower-route approach to the row-10 platform and determine which object/resource activation supplies the same Type-0x01 actor or opens the upper exit band.
